options.text: Sharing your password with the class
options.rationale: Passwords should stay private, not be shared.

items.stem: You cannot see your document on the screen anymore. What is the best first step?

options.text: Look in the folder where you saved it, using its name
options.rationale: Correct: saved files live in folders and can be found by name.
Saved files are usually still in a folder.

options.text: Turn the computer off and on ten times
options.rationale: Restarting repeatedly does not find a saved file.

options.text: Type the whole thing again straight away
options.rationale: First check the folder before retyping.
